about_the_game:
Jack of All Trades
The latest technologies have sped up production, but someone has to maintain them. Fires, broken gears, steam leaks, and countless other problems await you.

No Rest for the Wicked
Breakdowns happen constantly. You can’t afford to lose focus for even a second—a broken factory doesn’t generate profit, and the bosses won’t tolerate that. To keep your job as an engineer, you must keep the factory running.

The Factory Must Grow
The plant is enormous, and as an engineer, you’ll gradually unlock new sections of it. Each day, you’ll climb the career ladder and gain access to more factory departments.

Alternate History
As you play, you’ll learn not only about your workplace but also about the game’s world. Here, history took a different turn—instead of inventing electricity, humanity focused on advancing steam technology, and the harsh conditions of industrialization leave workers no time to rest.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium Dual CPU E2180 2.00GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: In this game, you'll take on the role of an engineer repairing machinery in a steampunk factory. You must keep an eye on the latest "marvels of technology"—they break down constantly, and the management isn't too happy about that.

English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian*
*languages with full audio support
